title: Migrate external pinning API keys to secretx URIs
description: Why: ExternalPinServiceConfig.api_key is a PinningApiKey newtype (crates/transit/src/retention/remote_pin_client.rs:18) whose inner String is deserialized directly from TOML. Operators must put the raw bearer token for Pinata / web3.storage / Filebase in the config file. Accepting a secretx: URI lets operators store pinning credentials in AWS Secrets Manager, Vault, env vars, etc. What to do: Change the TOML field to accept either a literal token string or a secretx: URI. At startup (after config load), resolve any secretx: URIs via secretx::from_uri().get().await to obtain the raw token bytes. Wrap the resolved value in PinningApiKey (or replace PinningApiKey with a SecretValue-backed type). PinningApiKey.as_bearer_header() is called by the pin client — that interface stays unchanged. The redacting Debug/Display must continue to work.
notes: Part of epic stoa-6c0f1855 (Integrate crate-secretsx). Blocked on stoa-f0b9ff15 (workspace wiring).
